obligations.subject: e41
obligations.ears: Both Japan and Korea preferred the "dot-to-dot method" because the method is mathematically more accurate, by using the simulated HIT values as agreed upon in Annex 2.

obligations.subject: e41
obligations.ears: Other Contracting Parties and NGOs were in favour of the "linear regression method", because the method is practical to figure out the corresponding HIT values to WADs.
